name: JEE Main
description: The national gateway to NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded technical institutes, and the qualifying exam for JEE Advanced. Two sessions a year, best score counted.

name: JEE Advanced
description: Admission test for the Indian Institutes of Technology. Two papers on the same day, and only the top handful of JEE Main candidates may sit it.

name: BITSAT
description: The single entrance test for the BITS Pilani campuses at Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad. Computer-based, with a bonus question set at the end.

name: VITEEE
description: Entrance test for the VIT Vellore, Chennai, Bhopal and Amaravati campuses. Held in slots across several days.

name: SRMJEEE
description: Entrance test for the SRM Institute of Science and Technology campuses across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana and Sikkim.

name: MHT CET
description: Maharashtra's state entrance test, used for engineering, pharmacy and agriculture seats in colleges across the state.

name: KCET
description: Karnataka's common entrance test for engineering, agriculture and pharmacy courses, run by KEA.

name: WBJEE
description: West Bengal's entrance test for undergraduate engineering, technology and pharmacy seats, including Jadavpur University.

name: GATE
description: Used for M.Tech and Ph.D admissions at IITs, NITs and IISc, and by many public-sector recruiters. Papers are held subject by subject across a week.

name: CAT
description: India's largest MBA entrance exam and the route into the IIMs. Three timed sections, and a sectional time limit you cannot borrow from.

name: XAT
description: Conducted by XLRI for its own programmes and accepted by a wide set of management institutes. Known for the decision-making section.

name: MAT
description: Held four times a year by AIMA, which makes it the most flexible of the MBA entrance tests. A useful backup if CAT timing goes wrong.

name: CMAT
description: Run by the NTA, and the score AICTE uses for admission to management programmes across participating institutions.

name: SNAP
description: The entrance test for the Symbiosis institutes. Three attempts in December, and your best score is the one that counts.

name: NMAT
description: NMIMS's own entrance test, with a long testing window and up to three attempts. Also accepted by a handful of other institutes.

name: ATMA
description: A comparatively relaxed MBA entrance test run by AIMS, often used to fill the last few admission slots of the season.

name: NEET UG
description: The single entrance test for MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS and veterinary seats in India. One paper, one rank list, all colleges.

name: NEET PG
description: The entrance test for MD, MS and diploma seats after MBBS, and the basis of the all-India and state counselling rounds.

name: CLAT
description: The gateway to the National Law Universities. One paper covering comprehension, reasoning, legal aptitude and maths.

name: AILET
description: National Law University Delhi's own entrance test for its five-year and one-year law programmes.

name: CUET UG
description: The single entrance test for central universities, covering arts, science, commerce and languages. You choose the subjects to be tested on.

name: NATA
description: Required for B.Arch admissions, and it tests drawing and visual reasoning alongside the usual maths and aptitude.

name: NID DAT
fullName: National Institute of Design - Design Aptitude Test
description: The two-stage entrance test for the National Institutes of Design, followed by a studio test and interview for shortlisted candidates.

name: UCEED
fullName: Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design
description: The entrance test for the IITs' B.Des programmes at Bombay, Delhi, Guwahati, Hyderabad and Gandhinagar.

name: NIFT Entrance
fullName: National Institute of Fashion Technology Entrance Exam
description: Creative ability test plus a general ability test, used for fashion design, textile design and fashion management programmes.

name: NCHM JEE
description: The entrance test for the IHMs and other hotel management institutes under the NCHMCT umbrella.

name: ICAR AIEEA
fullName: All India Entrance Examination for Admission (ICAR)
description: The ICAR test for agricultural university seats, and the route to central scholarships in agriculture and allied sciences.

name: NIMCET
description: The common entrance test for the MCA programmes offered by the National Institutes of Technology.
